long_biography.plain_text:
James Hopkins began with the renovation of a Suffolk cottage in 1985, work that developed into Hopkins & Moore. He then founded Hopkins Homes and built it into a substantial East Anglian housebuilder. He controlled the group before its acquisition in 2022, making his role that of founder-owner rather than simply a company director.

When Terra Firma acquired Hopkins Homes, Hopkins retained Hopkins & Moore and relaunched it as Denbury Homes. He remains executive chairman and controls its holding company, while a managing director and chief executive oversee day-to-day operations. His continuing business is private regional housebuilding; its assets, borrowing and development pipeline belong to corporate entities, not automatically to him personally.
